# GEONGAMEHUB PORTABLE PROMPTS

This folder contains reusable task instructions for GeonGameHub.

Before using any task prompt, read:
../copilot-instructions.md

Each prompt is designed to be portable and reusable.

Rules:
- Inspect the current repository before implementation.
- Follow the master Copilot instructions first.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Preserve existing game systems and dependencies.
- Test changes before claiming completion.
- Keep final responses short.
